prerequisites: Having completed the previous courses foreseen in the Master's study plan.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the knowledge acquired during the Master's to solve real mechatronic problems that arise in the company.

syllabus_topics: Formalization of Educational Cooperation Agreement (Universidad de Oviedo and host entity)
Elaboration of a training project for each student, including personal data, tutor names, competencies, tasks, dates, schedule, location, and financial aid (if any).
Defining educational objectives and professional activities for the training program.
Designing practice content directly related to the studies.
Communication of modifications to external internship conditions.
Work plan for students who choose to do TFM/internships in a research group within the University.
Student duties: adherence to the training project, communication of incidents, submission of final report and evaluation questionnaire.
Academic tutor duties: ensuring proper activity, confidentiality, contact with company tutor and student, evaluating activity alignment, issuing valuation report, proposing internship rescission.

Company/entity tutor duties: hosting the student, organizing activities, informing about organization, ensuring training and necessary means, supervising activities, coordinating with academic tutor, issuing final report, maintaining confidentiality.
assessment_rules: The academic tutor awards the final grade based on a report from the company tutor, the student's final internship report, and the academic tutor's own evaluation. If the required documentation is not submitted by the deadline, a 'not presented' grade will be issued. Professional or work experience, training scholarships, and non-curricular external internships can be recognized for credits if requested within fifteen days of matriculation and approved by the Technical Credit Recognition Commission, resulting in an 'apt (without qualification)' grade.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
